description: This PHP source file defines the 'Homestuff' class, which manages various widgets and homepage components for the vtiger CRM platform. It includes methods for adding, retrieving, and displaying different types of widgets such as modules, RSS feeds, dashboards, reports, notebooks, and URLs. Additionally, it contains utility functions related to group task listings and user-specific notebook contents.

classes.name: Homestuff
classes.description: A class to manage homepage widgets and related functionalities for the vtiger CRM platform, including adding, retrieving, and displaying modules, RSS feeds, dashboards, reports, notebooks, and URLs.

methods.name: addStuff
methods.description: Adds a new widget or homepage component to the database based on the instance properties such as type, title, and other relevant parameters.

methods.name: getHomePageFrame
methods.description: Retrieves the list of widgets configured for the user's homepage, considering module activation and permissions.

methods.name: getSelectedStuff
methods.description: Returns information about a specific widget given its ID and type.

methods.name: getHomePageStuff
methods.description: Fetches the detailed contents of a specific widget based on its ID and type.

methods.name: getModuleFilters
methods.description: Retrieves filter and view details for a module-type widget.

methods.name: getRssDetails
methods.description: Gets RSS feed content and related details for RSS-type widgets.

methods.name: getDashDetails
methods.description: Fetches dashboard widget details, including chart types and configurations.

methods.name: getdisplayChart
methods.description: Generates the display content for dashboard charts.

methods.name: getReportChartDetails
methods.description: Retrieves information about report chart widgets and optionally displays the chart.

methods.name: getDisplayReportChart
methods.description: Generates the visual chart for a report widget.

methods.name: getDefaultDetails
methods.description: Returns default homepage content such as top accounts, leads, tickets, etc., based on the user's preferences.

methods.name: getNotebookContents
methods.description: Fetches the contents of a user's notebook from the database.

methods.name: getWidgetURL
methods.description: Retrieves the URL associated with a widget, if applicable.
